Days of the week in Portuguese with its abbreviations:

Sunday - Domingo - Dom (from latin Domine, roughly Lord's Day)

Monday - Segunda-feira - Seg (Second Market Day)

Tuesday - Terça-feira - Ter (Third Market Day)

Wednesday - Quarta-feira - Qua (Fourth Market Day)

Thursday - Quinta-feira - Qui (Fifth Market Day)

Friday - Sexta-feira - Sex (Sixth Market Day)

Saturday - Sábado - Sáb (from Latin Sabatum, from Hebrew Shabbat, rest day)

Now, informally, it is very common to omit the "feira":
